svg.desc: Three columns. Pointwise: predict each item's click with log loss; calibrated but blind to the group. Pairwise RankNet: for pairs with different labels, minimise log(1 + exp(-(s_i - s_j))); all swaps cost the same. Listwise LambdaMART: RankNet gradients weighted by the change in NDCG from swapping the pair, so mistakes at the top dominate.

svg.text: Why |ΔNDCG|: move the one relevant item from rank 2 to rank 1 → ΔNDCG = 1 − 1/log2(3) = 0.37;

svg.text: from rank 10 to rank 9 → 1/log2(10) − 1/log2(11) = 0.01. Same pair loss, 30× different weight.

svg.text: LambdaMART = LambdaRank gradients + boosted trees: a smooth stand-in for NDCG.
